_meta.note: VM-A lock #4 PAC / foreign-lobby affirmative search, tick 2: finishes Warner foreign_policy_restraint q3, then Vindman + Kiggans. Candidate IDs: Warner S6VA00093, Vindman H4VA07234, Kiggans H2VA02064. Dollar figures are raw pas2 rows (24K = contribution, 24A = IE against), not deduplicated totals. Earmarked conduit lines are flagged in each note. Slugs mark-warner / eugene-vindman / jen-kiggans / tim-kaine were confirmed present in usmcmin-com-fleet-publisher/data/scorecard.json (read-only check); records keep the slug@VA key shape from T1.
